test_cases.description: HubClient constructor creates a single shared httpx.AsyncClient with the correct base URL and Authorization Bearer header applied to every request.
preconditions: afhub package is installed in a Python 3.12+ environment
httpx>=0.27 is available
test_cases.expected: HubClient instance is created; its internal httpx.AsyncClient has base_url='https://hub.example.com' and default headers include 'Authorization: Bearer test-pat-123'
